notes.title: Class of '09: The Re-Up - Now on Steam!
notes.content:
After 2 years the Class of '09 re up is here, appropriately titled Class of '09: The Re-Up. This title will feature a new batch of story stems totaling out to be [b]twice the length of the first game.[/b]
Explore other characters and other locations in Nicole's world as you navigate to 7 brand new endings and bonus content.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2318310/Class_of_09_The_ReUp/]Link to Class of  '09: The Re-Up store page[/url]

Be sure to wishlist it today!

notes.title: Class of '09 Just Re-Graduated!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40601538/3764005d0752424b4e9985c35c5ce949cdb25552.png[/img]

A little over a year has passed since the initial release of Class of '09 and the feedback/commercial success was so positive we felt it was right to give the playerbase a significant upgrade to the game at no additional charge.

The following things have been added to the base game of Class of '09 in this V1.2 upgrade like:

[list]
-Updated stability to the core game's playback mechanic.

-An ending tracker system on the main menu so players can easily archive what they've done among the 15 sprawling endings.

-Additional lore and context to every existing stem via text messages through your very own G-Mobile phone.

[b]-A bonus stem, only accessible if you 100% the game like a true Nicoleist.[/b]
[/list]
We hope you find these quality of life and lore updates enjoyable next time you stream of play Class of '09!

notes.title: CUTSCENE ISSUES FIXED
notes.content:
Restart your Steam to trigger a Class of '09 update. A few streamers were having issues with the game when multitasking, issues like cutscenes popping up error messages or a black screen with just audio. Attached is an image of what the cutscenes are generally supposed to look like.

Happy to announce a new way of coding these has been implemented, and tested while the PCs were throttled with a render in the background, and it seems things have held up properly so far. If you continue to have issues, please let us know exactly what is happening in the discussion section.
